model: 3S 850 mAh pack of the Pavo20 Pro II

sources.description: The stakeholder's note of 2026-11-08 about the BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro II (sources/stakeholder-pavo.txt; data/flight-logs/inventory.json): a 3S 850 mAh battery; not a datasheet.

The aircraft's own parameters in stakeholder-pavo-log_34_UnknownDate.bin: MOT_BAT_VOLT_MAX 13.05 V and MOT_BAT_VOLT_MIN 9.9 V over three cells (4.35 V and 3.3 V per cell); the owner's settings, not a cell datasheet. The same log's BATT_CAPACITY is 720 mAh.

Fitted on the stakeholder's stakeholder-pavo-log_34_UnknownDate.bin by scripts/check-battery-logs.mjs (model C, test-results/validation/battery-logs.json): the series resistance and both RC branches that minimise the RMS voltage error over that flight with the chen-2006 curve (12.3 mV RMS); on the 17 logs not used in the fit the error is 20 to 185 mV RMS. A fit to flight voltage and current, not a bench measurement; adopted by the stakeholder on 2026-11-14.

The open-circuit curve shape of Chen and Rincón-Mora, Accurate electrical battery model capable of predicting runtime and I-V performance, IEEE Trans. Energy Conversion 21(2), 2006, eq. (2), scaled onto the card's cell window; chosen because it fits the stakeholder's logs better than the linear curve (TASK-104).

applicability: Three cells and 0.85 Ah as the stakeholder states them (the logs set BATT_CAPACITY 720 mAh); cell voltages from the owner's MOT_BAT_VOLT_* settings, which suit a high-voltage pack; chemistry not known. Schema 2 (2026-11-14): the chen-2006 curve and the series resistance and RC branches fitted on log 34, the stakeholder's choice; the pack's thermal values are not known (the logs hold no temperature and the stakeholder chose not to measure it), so its temperature stays the air's.
